payload.text: hv in vc's window, received by 2026-11-20 06:46Z by date -u, hv's words: "Remember, this Intent patch for hash-based IDs is P0, or P(-1). Or however I can stipulate UTTMOST PRIORITY." The Desk's rule from now, tightening decision 249's order: (1) an intent-* ask never waits for another estate: it is granted at once on the host and lane its seat names, whatever the load, and if another estate's run holds that lane it goes beside it in the heavy lane or to gyges, as its seat prefers; (2) another estate's heavy-class run starts only while no intent-* heavy-class run is running or waiting and none is announced to come within its length, so intent-vc's seats announce each heavy run to the Desk as soon as they know it; (3) a run already started is not stopped (decision 241), and light runs go as the lanes allow. devbin's idle cc and dc are offered to intent-vc for any part of the fix, its call. Told by message by 06:47Z: intent-vc and the other estate's vc.
